## Incident Report: Network Security Incident (2024-11-26)

**Incident Summary**
Analysis of the packet capture from 2024-11-26 reveals a Windows enterprise workstation infected with NetSupport RAT, actively communicating with external command-and-control infrastructure while attempting lateral movement within the domain.

---

**Victim Host Information**

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| IPv4 Address | 10.11.26.183 |
| MAC Address | d0:57:7b:ce:fc:8b |
| Windows Hostname | DESKTOP-B8TQK49 |
| Logged-in User | oboomwald |
| Domain | nemotoads.health |

---

**Malware Identification**

| Field | Details |
|-------|---------|
| Malware Family | NetSupport RAT |
| Attribution | Signature-confirmed (ETPRO TROJAN alerts, User-Agent header) |
| User-Agent | NetSupport Manager/1.3 |
| Detection Method | IDS signatures (Suricata ETPRO rules) + behavioral indicators |

---

**Indicators of Compromise (IOCs)**

**Primary C&C Endpoint**
- IP: 194.180.191.64:443
- Protocol: HTTP/1.1 masqueraded over TLS
- URL: http://194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm (POST checkins)
- Traffic Pattern: Regular C&C communications starting at 67.184 seconds, continuing with ~60-second intervals

**Malicious Domain**
- Domain: modandcrackedapk.com
- Resolved IP: 193.42.38.139
- Port: 443 (TLS)
- SNI: modandcrackedapk.com
- Activity: Initial DNS lookups at 35.687 seconds; multiple HTTPS connections for command relay

**Secondary HTTP Connections**
- Geolocation Lookup: 104.26.1.231:80 (/location/loca.asp)
- File Download: 23.53.127.105:80 (/assets/Owner/arm/ProcessMAU.txt)

**Lateral Movement Activity**
- Target: NEMOTODES-DC (10.11.26.3)
- SMB Exploitation Attempts:
  - NTMLSSP unicode asn1 overflow attempts on port 139
  - EfsRpc (Encrypting File System Remote Protocol) abuse via ncacn_np
  - Multiple IPC$ share connection attempts (\\NEMOTODES-DC\IPC$)

---

**Attack Timeline**
1. 35.6s: DNS resolution of malicious domain modandcrackedapk.com
2. 35.8s: TLS connection to 193.42.38.139:443 (SNI=modandcrackedapk.com)
3. 36-38s: Multiple HTTPS connections to modandcrackedapk.com for command relay
4. 62-75s: File download attempt from 23.53.127.105/assets/Owner/arm/ProcessMAU.txt
5. 67.2s: Initial C&C contact to 194.180.191.64:443
6. 67.4s+: Continuous C&C POST checkins every 60 seconds (indicating active RAT session)
7. Throughout: Multiple SMB exploitation attempts against domain controller for lateral movement

---

**Findings**
- The infected workstation maintains persistent C&C communication with NetSupport RAT operators
- Lateral movement exploitation targeting the domain controller indicates post-compromise privilege escalation activity
- Suspicious file downloads (ProcessMAU.txt) suggest payload staging or secondary tool deployment
- User account oboomwald is compromised and actively executing malware
